text_simplified: The verse commanding protection of one's family from the Fire is a great foundation for the obligation of caring for and raising children. Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) explained it as: teach them and discipline them. The Prophet ﷺ affirmed this, stating that every shepherd is responsible for his flock. It is a reminder that Allah will question the servant about this amanah on the Day of Resurrection; some scholars even said the parent is asked about his child before the child is asked about his parent. Abdullah ibn Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: "Discipline your son, for you will be asked about him."
